messages:
Alex P: Thinking out loud — proposal for a new packaging primitive: 'Throughput Units' (TUs). Each TU purchases a small slice of GPU-minutes + a routing QoS token. Goal: let customers buy predictable throughput for low-latency streaming use cases instead of pure token-based pricing. Thoughts?
Priya: love the intent. Need concrete conversion: how many tokens/TU and how do we price relative to committed tokens? Also: migration path for existing customers?
Ben: finance: need cost model. If 1 TU = 0.5 GPU-minute, what's our margin at current infra rates? Also impact on revenue recognition for reserved contracts.
Sara: eng: two engineering flags: 1) we must be able to meter TUs accurately at the per-route level, 2) need fallback semantics when TU pool depleted (auto-failover to on-demand with QoS degrade). Instrumentation effort ~2 sprints.
Alex P: initial conversion sketch:
```
1 TU = 30s GPU compute (NVIDIA A10 equivalent)
1 TU ~ expected to serve ~5k streaming tokens (varies by model)
Pack sizes: 1000 TU, 5k TU, 20k TU
```
Priya: launch gating — require (a) two pilots (one enterprise, one AI-native), (b) Console UI for TU dashboards, (c) pricing for add-on TU burst pack, (d) legal SOW language for TU settlement. OK?
@csm_mike: can route two pilot candidates (RetailCo, FinTechX). RetailCo cares about predictable p99 latency, FinTechX wants strict audit trail on consumption.
Ben: add-on questions: overage reconciliation: do we bill excess TU usage at defined overage rate or convert to on-demand tokens? Need to standardize in contract.
Sara: ops note: prefer overage -> soft-fail to on-demand token billing + alert. Hard fail will hurt customers.
Priya: UX: pricing table mock (rounded):
- 1k TU pack = $3,500/mo (list)
- 5k TU pack = $15k/mo
- 20k TU pack = $52k/mo (volume discount)
Also propose 'trial faucet' giving 50 TUs for new signup to demo streaming perf.
Ben: run sensitivity: what if customers use >3x expected token/TU? Recommend guardrails: per-route rate cap and alert thresholds.
Alex P: next steps: engineering estimate, legal draft SOW clause, pilot opt-in form, and add to roadmap as 'TU pilot Q2'. Anyone want to pick owner? :raising_hand:
Priya: I'll own product and pilot coordination. Ben can you do the revenue model by EOD Friday?
Ben: yes, will run numbers and flag revenue recognition implications.
Sara: I'll scope the metering work, pinging eng-infra for quota hooks. Ops-bot: create a tracking ticket?
ops-bot: Created TICKET-4537: 'TU packaging pilot — infra & metering' assigned to eng-infra, due 2026-05-08. :white_check_mark:
Alex P: thanks. Keeping this thread as the canonical convo for TU packaging. We'll sync in next product triage.
